videos.script:
Most screens are lists, and most of what goes wrong with lists happens when they change.

{{lists}} In React, a list is an array of elements, made with map. Each one needs a key, and React tells you when one is missing.

{{keys}} A key tells React which item is which between two renders. You will see why the key has to come from the data.

{{bug}} Then the bug an index key makes. You will type a note beside one session, reverse the order, and watch the note stay where it was, beside the wrong session.

{{conditional}} After that, how a component draws one thing or another, with no if statement in sight.

{{zero}} One of those tools has a trap: a stray zero that appears on the screen when a count is empty.

{{empty}} And last, the empty list. A screen with nothing on it should say so.
